using System;
using System.Buffers.Binary;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.server;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class LuaRunnerFunctionsTests
    {
        private class TestLogger : ILogger
        {
            public string LastLogMessage { get; private set; }
            public LogLevel LastLogLevel { get; private set; }
            public EventId LastEventId { get; private set; }
            public Exception LastException { get; private set; }
            public object[] LastArgs { get; private set; }

            public IDisposable BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null;
            public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => true;

            public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception exception, Func<TState, Exception, string> formatter)
            {
                LastLogLevel = logLevel;
                LastEventId = eventId;
                LastException = exception;
                LastLogMessage = formatter(state, exception);
                if (state is IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string, object>> kvps)
                {
                    var args = new System.Collections.Generic.List<object>();
                    foreach (var kvp in kvps)
                    {
                        if (kvp.Key == "{OriginalFormat}") continue;
                        args.Add(kvp.Value);
                    }
                    LastArgs = args.ToArray();
                }
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryDecodeLargeArray_LogsError_WhenLengthTooLong()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new TestLogger();
            var runner = CreateLuaRunnerWithLogger(logger);

            // Prepare data with length > int.MaxValue (simulate overflow)
            // We use 0xFFFFFFFF (uint.MaxValue) which is > int.MaxValue
            byte[] dataBytes = new byte[4];
            BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt32BigEndian(dataBytes, uint.MaxValue);
            ReadOnlySpan<byte> data = dataBytes;

            int constStrErrId;

            // Act
            bool result = CallTryDecodeLargeArray(runner, ref data, out constStrErrId);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            Assert.Equal(runner.constStrs.MsgPackArrayTooLong, constStrErrId);
            Assert.NotNull(logger.LastLogMessage);
            Assert.Contains("Array length is too long", logger.LastLogMessage);
            Assert.Contains(uint.MaxValue.ToString(), logger.LastLogMessage);
            Assert.Equal(LogLevel.Error, logger.LastLogLevel);
        }

        private LuaRunner CreateLuaRunnerWithLogger(ILogger logger)
        {
            // We create a LuaRunner with minimal required parameters and inject the logger.
            // Some parameters can be null or default as they are not used in this test.
            return new LuaRunner(
                LuaMemoryManagementMode.Default,
                null,
                LuaLoggingMode.None,
                new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>(),
                ReadOnlyMemory<byte>.Empty,
                false,
                null,
                null,
                "0.0.0.0",
                logger);
        }

        private static bool CallTryDecodeLargeArray(LuaRunner runner, ref ReadOnlySpan<byte> data, out int constStrErrId)
        {
            // The method is private static inside LuaRunner.Functions.cs partial class.
            // We use reflection to invoke it for testing.

            var type = typeof(LuaRunner);
            var method = type.GetMethod("TryDecodeLargeArray", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static);
            if (method == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("TryDecodeLargeArray method not found");

            object[] parameters = new object[] { runner, data, null };
            bool result = (bool)method.Invoke(null, parameters);
            constStrErrId = (int)parameters[2];
            data = (ReadOnlySpan<byte>)parameters[1];
            return result;
        }
    }
}
